beats.speaker: narration
beats.text: That evening, term sheet still in hand, Riley wants the whole shape of it laid out.

beats.prompt: The past: the trust you built with someone else's ear before any of this was real.
The present: how you answered the review without swinging first.
The future: the offer that just landed, turning everything with it.

beats.speaker: client
beats.text: "Quiz me on the new one. If the Wheel means nothing's permanent, doesn't that mean this offer could just disappear too?"

options.text: It could turn again — that's the point, nothing here is fixed high or low.
No, once you sign it's permanent forever.
Permanence has nothing to do with this card.

elaboration: What goes up comes around — nothing here is permanent, high or low. That's not a threat, it's just how the wheel works.

beats.speaker: client
beats.text: "So am I supposed to just brace for the next downturn the whole time?"

options.text: No — stay balanced at the center, even as things spin, instead of bracing for the drop.
Balance isn't part of this card.

elaboration: Stay balanced at the center, even as things spin around you — and everything's connected, so what you choose now shapes what the wheel brings back.

beats.speaker: narration
beats.text: "One thread ties all three: the trust you built, the strength you found when it counted, and now, the turn you're actually standing in."

beats.speaker: client
beats.text: "Yeah. I think I've been waiting for the other shoe to drop instead of just standing in the turn while it's actually good. Thanks."
